mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 2 months), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions characterized by high residential construction activity, rising consumer spending, and strong GDP growth, the S&P 500 tends to experience positive forward returns as investors anticipate sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where HOUST > 1400, RSAFS > 350000, and GDPC1 > 11500 (all as of t-5mo), or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past 3 months indicates robust manufacturing activity and supply chain resilience, which supports corporate profit growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction permits exceed 1400 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances (HOUST > 1400 for 2 months), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in the consumer price index signals a monetary policy response to cooling inflation, which reduces the risk of stagflation and supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.0% for 2 months), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
